meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页操作、填表、截图与数据抓取
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要操作网页,手动填表、截图或抓数据很耗时
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser tasks like form filling, screenshots, and data extraction.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat browser chores like filling forms and grabbing data.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会调用 agent-browser 命令操作浏览器:打开网址、抓取页面上的可点击元素、点击和填写表单、截图存 PDF,并读取页面文本、链接、输入框等数据。
howto.when: 当你说要打开某个网站、填写表单、截图等操作网页时,它会接管浏览器逐步执行。

say.text: 打开 https://example.com,给我截一张全页图
say.note: 会打开页面并保存整页截图

say.text: 把这个登录表单填好并提交
say.note: 依次填入输入框后点击提交按钮

say.text: 抓一下这个页面里所有商品的价格
say.note: 用 snapshot 和 get 读出页面文本并整理

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude drives a browser through the agent-browser CLI: open URLs, snapshot interactive elements, click and fill fields, take screenshots or PDFs, and read page text, links and inputs.
howto.when_en: Use when you need to open a website, fill a form, take a screenshot, etc., or extract page data — Claude takes over the browser.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com and take a full-page screenshot
say_en.note: Opens the page and saves a full-page image

say_en.text: Fill in this login form and submit it
say_en.note: Types into the fields then clicks submit

say_en.text: Extract every product price on this page
say_en.note: Reads page text through snapshot and get
